clue.text: Surface where amateur has to ride in foam

indicators.note: the ride is placed in the foam, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: surf is the foam of breaking waves
to trot is to ride a horse at a moderate pace

explanation.surface: A novice horseman is told to ride through the sea's foam, as if on a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Artificial grass used on sports pitches is a playing surface, known by this trademark name.

clue.text: Quiet has upset rulers

parts.note: SH is the call for quiet

indicators.note: upset means the letters of the word has are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A calm person has been unsettled by those in power.
explanation.definitionFit: Shahs were the monarchs of Iran, so they are rulers.

clue.text: Front page skills rising in stages

parts.note: ro is an abbreviation of recto, the front (right-hand) page of a leaf

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word for skills is read from bottom to top

parts.note: arts are skills or crafts

explanation.surface: Talents shown on a newspaper's front page climb through successive phases.
explanation.definitionFit: Rostra are raised platforms for speakers, a kind of stage.

clue.text: Everybody is in mostly slim growing bodies

indicators.note: is in says the word for everybody sits inside the shortened word for slim
mostly means the last letter of the word for slim is dropped

parts.note: thin means slim
all means everybody

explanation.surface: Everyone is reportedly in a mostly slender shape while still growing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts THIN to THI, which then holds ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A thallus is the undifferentiated plant body of algae, fungi and lichens, so these are vegetative bodies that grow.

clue.text: Device for locating woman embraced by bishop

indicators.note: embraced by puts the woman's name inside the letters for the bishop

parts.note: RR stands for Right Reverend, the title of a bishop
Ada is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A gadget for finding a woman who has been hugged by a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: Radio-wave detection equipment is used to locate aircraft and ships.

clue.text: Fanatical propagandists deliriously go and stop in Hell with Eastern Royal Society

indicators.note: deliriously means the letters of go, stop and Hell are thrown wildly into a new order

explanation.surface: Zealots raving, telling people to go and halt in Hell, alongside a learned scientific body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deliriously' scrambles the three fodder words; 'and', 'in' and 'with' are only links. Hot gospellers are named for their fiery preaching.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot gospellers are fervent evangelical preachers, zealous spreaders of their message.

clue.text: One's no good after foolish vanity in stretching before cast

indicators.note: after says the pieces for one and no good come behind the word for vanity

parts.note: pretension is foolish vanity or affectation
one is I, and the 's is read as has, joining it to what follows

explanation.surface: Someone admits being worthless after absurd conceit while limbering up ahead of a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before cast' is about concrete: steel tendons are tensioned before the concrete is cast round them.
explanation.definitionFit: In construction, steel tendons are put under tension before the concrete is poured, a technique of stretching ahead of casting.

clue.text: Three Englishmen and father getting right in to create banner

parts.note: Roy is a man's name
Al is a man's name
Stan is a man's name

indicators.note: getting right in places the letter for right inside the word for father

parts.note: dad is father

explanation.surface: Three men and a dad get things right to make a flag.
explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Standard is the flag flown by the British monarch, a banner.

clue.text: Holding mysterious opinions of some rites when broadcast

definitions.note: the definition describes the noun's state: the holding of secret, initiated beliefs

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of some rites are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Arcane beliefs drawn from certain rituals, when transmitted over the airwaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric doctrine is that understood only by a select inner circle, so it is the holding of mysterious views.

clue.text: Cries aloud for shellfish containing iodine

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: containing says the shellfish word holds the iodine symbol

parts.note: clams are shellfish
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: Someone shouts out demanding seafood that has iodine in it.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something publicly and loudly is to make it known by crying it out.

clue.text: South African talk of family histories

parts.note: gas is idle talk or chatter

explanation.surface: A South African chats about the chronicles of a family.
explanation.definitionFit: Long multi-generation narratives such as the Forsyte series are called by this Norse-derived word.

clue.text: Rubbish or Turner?

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: Was the painter Turner's work rubbish or not?
explanation.walkthrough: Turner looks like the painter, but it means anything that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning part of a machine, such as a helicopter's blades, is something that turns.

clue.text: Former governor's an actor

definitions.meaning: Sarah ... was formerly Governor of Alaska
Michael ... is a Monty Python actor

explanation.surface: A one-time state governor turns out to be a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname is shared by the former Alaska governor Sarah and the comic actor Michael.

clue.text: Highlander's relief after record is overturned

definitions.note: the definition is possessive: the answer is a thing belonging to a Highlander, a noun

indicators.note: after puts the help word behind the turned record
is overturned means the record's letters are turned upside down, read bottom to top in this down entry

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record
aid is relief or help

explanation.surface: A Scot feels relief once a record has been flipped.
explanation.definitionFit: The tartan cloak worn over the shoulder is traditional Scottish Highland dress.

clue.text: Plain returns on the whole

indicators.note: returns means the words are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: all is the whole

explanation.surface: A modest yield on the entire investment.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a grassy treeless plain in South America.

clue.text: When it recovers use some fertiliser

indicators.note: use some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Advice to apply a little plant food once the garden is recovering.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate, saltpetre, has long been used as a fertiliser.

clue.text: Ornamental hanging shows French cup on left

indicators.note: on means the cup word comes on top of, before, the letter for left

parts.note: tasse is French for cup

explanation.surface: A decorative drape shows a French cup standing on the left side.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuft of threads hanging from curtains or cushions as decoration.

clue.text: One with curve is fashionable

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
a conic is a curve such as an ellipse or parabola, from a section of a cone

explanation.surface: A figure with curves is in vogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with iconic status is celebrated and much admired, hence stylish and in fashion.

clue.text: Before one's time to seize advantage

indicators.note: to seize means the outer letters grab the advantage word inside them

parts.note: one is A, as in a single thing
van is short for advantage in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: Someone ahead of their era is quick to grab a winning edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Before one's time' reads as a phrase, but only 'Before' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for in front, as in avant-garde, describes what comes first or ahead.

clue.text: Potato dish needs masses of fish eggs, note

parts.note: roes are masses of fish eggs
ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A recipe for a potato dish calls for lots of caviar and a musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss fried cake of grated potato, also spelt rosti.

clue.text: Retain fresh lining tissue

indicators.note: fresh means new, so the letters of Retain are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions to keep fresh the tissue lining something.
explanation.definitionFit: The light-sensitive layer lining the back of the eyeball is a tissue.

clue.text: Kennedy, for example, deserted his church

parts.note: D is used as an abbreviation for deserted in records
Kennedy was a Roman Catholic, so his church is Rome

explanation.surface: President Kennedy is said to have abandoned his own place of worship.
explanation.walkthrough: Kennedy here is the New York airport, not the president.
explanation.definitionFit: A drome is short for aerodrome, and Kennedy airport in New York is one.

clue.text: This slice is more risky

definitions.meaning: comparative of rash, meaning more reckless

explanation.surface: A cut of meat is said to be more dangerous.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a thin cut of bacon and the comparative of an adjective meaning reckless.

clue.text: Strand of colour that's loud

definitions.meaning: to leave someone isolated, as on a desert island
a firework or signal rocket that explodes with a loud bang

explanation.surface: A thread of some shade that is garish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strand' is a verb, not a thread; 'loud' means noisy, not garish.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for abandoning, a brownish-crimson shade, and an explosive distress rocket.

clue.text: Short lawyer's extraordinarily large motorbikes (without sidecars)

indicators.note: short means the lawyer's title is cut down to its opening letters

parts.note: a solicitor is a lawyer; the 's joins it to the next piece
OS stands for outsize, extraordinarily large

explanation.surface: A shortish solicitor rides enormous motorcycles.
explanation.definitionFit: A solo machine is a motorcycle ridden on its own, with no sidecar attached.

clue.text: Instructions to keep New Year on board

indicators.note: on board means inside a ship, so the new year word goes within the letters for steamship

parts.note: SS is a steamship, the vessel one is aboard
Tet is the Vietnamese New Year festival

explanation.surface: Orders to keep celebrating the New Year aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A proofreader's mark meaning let it stand, telling the printer to retain the original text.

clue.text: Note male chasing skirt

indicators.note: chasing means the letter for male follows behind the skirt

parts.note: a mini is a short skirt

explanation.surface: A note about a man pursuing women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skirt' is slang for women, but here it is the garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical half note, worth two crotchets.

clue.text: Woman taking nuts before lunch

parts.note: nuts means mad, crazy
AM is morning, the time before noon

explanation.surface: A lady eating nuts ahead of her midday meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A polite form of address for a lady.

clue.text: Description of arms filling trousers?

parts.note: breeches are trousers, and a gun is loaded at the rear of its barrel, the breech, rather than the muzzle

explanation.surface: A picture of limbs stuffed into a pair of trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arms' are weapons, not limbs; the breech is the back of the barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Firearms loaded at the back of the barrel are described with this term, punning on breeches as trousers.

clue.text: Drunk star's performing sacred syllable unknown in science

indicators.note: drunk means reeling, so the letters of star are jumbled

parts.note: the possessive 's adds no letter
on means performing, as on stage
om is the sacred syllable chanted in Hindu and Buddhist meditation
Y is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: An intoxicated celebrity chants a holy syllable in the science of the heavens.
explanation.definitionFit: The scientific study of celestial bodies and space.
